lines.zh: 我先跳两下，才飞得起来。
lines.en: I hop twice before I can take off.

lines.zh: 翅膀折起来，我在石上走。
lines.en: Wings folded, I walk on the stone.

lines.zh: 落在沙滩，一摇一摆地挪。
lines.en: Landing on the sand, I waddle along.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴朝下，像一根钓竿。
lines.en: My long beak points down like a fishing rod.
My claws grip poorly, so I walk slowly.
My wingtips drag across the reefs.
The wind rises; I listen as I walk.
These few steps cost more than flying.
I stroll along the coastline.
I shake my wings and the membrane flares.
I stop to rest my feet; it's exhausting.

lines.zh: 我拍打双翼，向前挪几步。
lines.en: I flap my wings and shuffle a few steps.
My shadow on the sand is huge.
I head for the water; there are fish there.
I spread my wings and bask.
I hang in the updraft, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 这身颜色，连我自己都觉得怪。
lines.en: Even I find my colors strange.
There's water on the wind.
I tilt my head and listen to the sea.
Wings folded, I look like a wooden post.
I am waiting for a school of fish to pass.

lines.zh: 远处有人在看我，随便吧。
lines.en: Someone is watching me from afar; let them.
My beak is open, but I am not eating.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，飞起来才好看。
lines.en: I only look good when I'm flying.

lines.zh: 静下来，翼膜在风里轻响。
lines.en: In the quiet, my wing membranes whisper.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，嘴张得很宽。
lines.en: I yawn, and my beak opens wide.

lines.zh: 礁石上很暖，我多站一会。
lines.en: The reef is warm; I'll stand a while longer.
I ignore everyone and watch the sky.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我先绕一圈。
lines.en: Stand still; let me circle you first.
I have circled halfway above your head.

lines.zh: 我这长嘴，天生适合挑东西。
lines.en: This long beak is built for prying things out.

lines.zh: 你这么高，我落的梁都找不到。
lines.en: You're so tall I can't find a perch.
This big beak is only for scooping fish.
Fish? Not fish. Disappointing.
Your hat would make a decent nest.
I circle you, and you turn to follow.
Don't reach out; my beak is sharp.

lines.zh: 你眼里有反光，我看得清。
lines.en: Your eyes catch the light; I see them clearly.
I settle on a branch and look down at you.
There is no fish smell on you.

lines.zh: 我们互相打量，谁也不让。
lines.en: We size each other up, neither yielding.

lines.zh: 你身后的风很好，我要用一下。
lines.en: The wind behind you is good; I'll use it.

lines.zh: 我的影子刚扫过你的脸。
lines.en: My shadow just swept across your face.

lines.zh: 别动，我在看你手上的东西。
lines.en: Don't move; I'm looking at what's in your hand.
My wing membrane! Not there!
Hollow bones hurt at a touch.
I stumble and hop away.
My wing tilts and I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 这一下打乱了我的盘旋。
lines.en: That broke my circling.
I shriek and fly up.
My beak got knocked and it's numb.
You hit me; that's rare.
I retreat to the edge of the rock.
A hole in my wing membrane; I can still glide.
Fish! I said it, fish!

lines.zh: 你把鱼举起来，我就下来。
lines.en: Raise the fish and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我不吃鱼，可我就是想抓。
lines.en: I don't eat fish, but I still want to catch it.

lines.zh: 那银光一晃，我就跟着了。
lines.en: One flash of silver and I follow.
Let me grab it, just once.

lines.zh: 我在你上方盘旋，别抬头。
lines.en: I circle above you; don't look up.
Mouth open — fish come in.

lines.zh: 你手上的鱼活得很精神。
lines.en: The fish in your hand looks lively.

lines.zh: 为了抓它，我连地都肯站。
lines.en: To catch it, I'll even stand on the ground.
That fish; let me practice my beak on it.

lines.zh: 我的骨头是中空的，别撞。
lines.en: My bones are hollow; don't bump me.
You crumpled my wing membrane.
I landed right on top of you.

lines.zh: 这地方太小，展不开翅膀。
lines.en: This space is too small to spread my wings.
Bump me and I take off at once.
Don't touch my long beak; it might snap.
I skim past your shoulder.
On the ground, I am clumsy.

lines.zh: 你站的地方挡我起飞了。
lines.en: You're standing in my takeoff line.
Move aside; I need to leap.
She spreads her wings on the cliff.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一股上升气流。
lines.en: We ride the same rising air.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴轻轻碰了碰她的。
lines.en: I touch my long beak gently to hers.

lines.zh: 崖壁上有我们去年留下的巢。
lines.en: The nest we left last year is on the cliff.

lines.zh: 翅膀并着，我们一起滑翔。
lines.en: Wings level, we glide together.
At this height, there is only us.

lines.zh: 我把颜色最亮的一面对着它。
lines.en: I turn my brightest colors toward it.
The wind is steady; today suits pairing.

lines.zh: 掠过水面时，我们几乎碰上。
lines.en: Skimming the water, we nearly touch.
The sea below the cliff is just quiet enough.
I take it up with my long beak.

lines.zh: 地上有什么，我低头看看。
lines.en: Something's on the ground; I look down.
This is shiny; I want it.
I grip it and fly up high.
My nest lacks exactly this piece.
I collect even what I don't eat; odd habit.

lines.zh: 它太沉了，我叼得歪歪的。
lines.en: It's heavy; I carry it crooked.

lines.zh: 我把它扔下去，再抓一次。
lines.en: I drop it and catch it again.
It will line my nest nicely.
This little thing is mine.
That fish; I have seen it.
Before I dive, I lock on.
The surface stirred; that's the target.
I fold my wings and prepare to drop.
This thing moves; I want it.
The target is in shallow water; good.
I fix on that fleck of silver.
That one; don't compete with me.

lines.zh: 我在空中画了个圈，定住它。
lines.en: I trace a circle in the air and mark it.

lines.zh: 它浮上来换气，正是时候。
lines.en: It surfaces for air; perfect timing.
Prey locked, and the wind is right.
I see its shadow.
From above, it cannot escape.
I want that one.
I skim low over the water.
It swims; I turn with it.
A bit closer and my beak will reach.
I wait for it to swim shallow.

lines.zh: 翅膀保持不动，全靠气流。
lines.en: Wings still, riding only the air.

lines.zh: 它以为躲在石头后面就安全。
lines.en: It thinks hiding behind a rock is safe.
I adjust my angle, ready to dive.
That shadow is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 它每浮上来一次，我就近一些。
lines.en: Each time it surfaces, I get closer.
Patience; sky hunters never lack it.
I swing behind it, downwind.
Fine ripples are forming on the water.
It's quiet below; time to move.
I aim my beak at its back.
One more circle and I dive.
One flick of my beak and the fish is up.

lines.zh: 我从天而降，砸在它身上。
lines.en: I drop from the sky onto it.
This jab goes through the scales.
I snatch it up and drop it again.
A sweep of my wing and it staggers.
My beak works like pincers.
My long beak clamps down; it can't break free.
This blow came from above.
I grip its spine.

lines.zh: 落地的时候，我顺便踩了一脚。
lines.en: I land and step on it in passing.
My claws dig into its hide.
I drag it onto the reef.
One strike from the air, and it comes fast.
One peck from me is enough.
I leap down from the cliff.
My wing shadow covers the ground first.
Cearadactylus has arrived.
The wind of this coast is mine to use.

lines.zh: 我张开双翼，比你想的宽。
lines.en: I spread my wings; wider than you think.
My landing makes almost no sound.
I skim in low over the sea.
Look up; look at the sky.

lines.zh: 我这一身颜色，很少见吧。
lines.en: My colors are rare, aren't they?

lines.zh: 崖顶的巢空着，我来看看。
lines.en: The clifftop nest is empty; I've come to look.

lines.zh: 我落在崖顶，先收起翅膀。
lines.en: I land on the cliff top and fold my wings.
The wind carried me here.
Three circles first, then we talk.
My cry is shrill; bear with it.
The coastline is long today.
I slip out from beneath the clouds.

lines.zh: 别抬头张着嘴，会掉东西。
lines.en: Don't stand there open-mouthed; things fall.
I'm here, and the wind came with me.
Fire caught my wing membrane and scorched it.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，翅膀折了一半。
lines.en: I hit the ground with one wing half-folded.
Seawater pours into my long beak.
The blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 箭穿破翼膜，我晃了一下。
lines.en: An arrow tears my wing; I lurch.

lines.zh: 那道光的力气，压得我抬不起翅。
lines.en: That light's force pins my wings down.
Too hungry to fly; I can only walk.

lines.zh: 雷劈在崖上，我翅膀都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the cliff and my wings go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我无处可滑。
lines.en: There is no wind in the void to glide on.
